news.title: 5th ODI, Bay Oval: India 209 (42.1 ov) beat NZ 187 (49 ov) by 22 runs; India win the series 3-1
news.note: Replay Room trigger: long + Shorts due today (within 24 h). Axar and Ishan Kishan 46 each; Arshdeep 3-30; Rohit 7 and Kohli 5 again; Yash Thakur's ODI debut and first wicket (Foxcroft). Capture Cricinfo + Cricbuzz pages now.

news.title: Records: India's first away ODI series win under Gambhir; NZ's unbeaten run of 11 home bilateral ODI series (seven years) ends; Arshdeep six off his first ball at No. 11; India dropped eight catches
news.note: Several clean on-screen numbers for news Shorts. Verify the 11-series streak and the catching numbers against Cricinfo before use.

news.title: India won by defending 209 while dropping eight catches; NZ scored at just over three an over through the middle overs; Santner batted with an injured hand (X-ray Monday)
news.note: The defence of a small total is the story: middle-overs squeeze is data-answerable from the capture (dot-ball %, control).

news.title: Pant cleared after a match simulation in Bengaluru; set to fly to NZ around 12 Nov, about a week before the Wellington Test
